title: Motorboat Mechanics and Service Technicians
description: Repair and adjust electrical and mechanical equipment of inboard or inboard-outboard boat engines.

tasks.text: Start motors and monitor performance for signs of malfunctioning, such as smoke, excessive vibration, or misfiring.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Detecting subtle equipment problems needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.

tasks.text: Document inspection and test results and work performed or to be performed.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Write test result reports from data

tasks.text: Mount motors to boats, and operate boats at various speeds on waterways to conduct operational tests.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual tool and equipment positioning in field

dwas.name: Position equipment using hand tools, power tools, or heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Repair engine mechanical equipment, such as power tilts, bilge pumps, or power take-offs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on engine teardown and repair

dwas.name: Repair defective engines or engine components.

emerging.task: Repair or replace engine mechanical equipment, such as power tilts, water pumps, bilge pumps, or power take-offs.
emerging.original_task: Repair engine mechanical equipment, such as power tilts, bilge pumps, or power take-offs.

tasks.text: Perform routine engine maintenance on motorboats, such as changing oil and filters.
Replace parts, such as gears, magneto points, piston rings, or spark plugs, and reassemble engines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Idle motors and observe thermometers to determine the effectiveness of cooling systems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Detecting subtle equipment problems needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.

tasks.text: Inspect and repair or adjust propellers or propeller shafts.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Mechanical component inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical components of vehicles to identify problems.
Repair defective engines or engine components.

tasks.text: Adjust carburetor mixtures, electrical point settings, or timing while motors are running in water-filled test tanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle component adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust vehicle components according to specifications.

tasks.text: Set starter locks and align and repair steering or throttle controls, using gauges, screwdrivers, or wrenches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical alignment of machinery requires hands

dwas.name: Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Disassemble and inspect motors to locate defective parts, using mechanic's hand tools and gauges.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Mechanical component inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical components of vehicles to identify problems.
Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Adjust generators and replace faulty wiring, using hand tools and soldering irons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on wiring repair in physical environment

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Repair or rework parts, using machine tools such as lathes, mills, drills, or grinders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of worn mechanical parts

dwas.name: Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
